title: Interpersonal neural synchrony: one label, many phenomena
title_zh: 人际神经同步：同一标签，众多现象
abstract: Brains synchronize interpersonally during social interaction, yet the term 'synchrony' is often used to describe phenomena with different origins and functional implications. In this article, we briefly synthesize and organize these phenomena according to their signal and coupling properties, highlighting the value of disambiguation for reproducibility, theoretical clarity, and translational impact.
abstract_zh: 在社会互动中，大脑会在人际间同步，但“同步”一词常被用来描述来源和功能含义各异的现象。本文简要综合并按信号与耦合特性组织这些现象，强调去歧义对可重复性、理论清晰度和转化影响的重要性。
